notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (SalesAssist Labs) building outbound SDR chat agents integrated into customers' CRMs and calendars. Currently evaluating Redwood Hosted API for fast time-to-value; likely path to Dedicated after POC if latency and cost profiles meet SLOs. Primary interest: streaming responses + tool/function calling (CRM updates, send email, schedule meetings).

Recent activity:
- 2026-02-18 discovery call (ff_2026-02-18_01): AE gave overview of hosted API + streaming. Prospect heavy on live demo of tool calls.
- 2026-02-20 technical deep-dive with SE (Marcus): reviewed webhook-pattern for tool calls, auth options (service accounts vs user tokens), KMS for keys.
- 2026-02-24 demo: live streaming + sample CRM update flow. Prospect asked for p95 numbers and failure modes.

Requirements / constraints (from notes):
- Workload: outbound SDR chat agent that composes personalized outreach, then executes actions: 1) create CRM note + update contact, 2) send email (via customer SMTP gateway), 3) schedule meeting on calendar.
- Latency SLOs: streaming start <= 200ms p50, <= 350ms p95 for first token; end-to-end tool call roundtrip (trigger -> CRM write) target <= 100ms typical, 300ms max. Prospect quote: "We can't surface responses to reps if the stream takes >300ms to start — users drop off."
- Throughput: pilot ~1000 outbound messages/day across 5 pilot customers; scale to ~100k+/day if product launches.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market margins, wants clear unit economics. Important: token-level cost breakdown and batching/caching guidance.
- Model preferences: open to curated open models; wants model catalog recommendations and quantization suggestions for Dedicated.
- Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to smaller model during spikes; prefer same API semantics for Hosted -> Dedicated.
- Security/compliance: SSO/SAML for admin UI, audit logging of tool calls, KMS-managed keys, data residency for EU customers. SOC2 required for production.

POC scope (requested):
- 2-week POC on Hosted API: implement streaming + tool calling flow (CRM write, send email, calendar invite).
- Measure p50/p95 token latencies, tool-call latencies, error/fallback behavior.
- Deliver price estimate for Dedicated (monthly commit) with expected unit costs at 100k messages/day.
- Provide suggested batching and cache settings and quantization profiles.

Sales notes / quotes:
- AE (Avery): "tight SLOs, low latency is a blocker for adoption — need numbers we can show to product team."
- Prospect PM (L. Martinez): "if streaming + tool-calling feels snappy, we'll sign a Dedicated commit after 3 months usage."

Next steps / action items:
- Schedule POC kickoff (Avery + Marcus) week of 2026-03-08.
- Share Hosted API latency p50/p95 benchmarks for streaming and function calls (deliver by 2026-03-03).
- Prep Dedicated pricing scenarios and a short doc on migration path from Hosted -> Dedicated.
- Provide security FAQ and SOC2 artifact stub to customer security contact.

Open questions / blockers:
- Clarify expected peak concurrency for pilot customers (asked prospect to send numbers).
- Confirm data residency needs for EU pilot customer (possible Dedicated-region requirement).
- Internal: finalize SE-run test harness for measuring tool-call latencies end-to-end.

Linked artifacts: pricing deck + security questionnaire in Drive. Jira RED-3421 created to track Dedicated pricing estimate.
